description: Use to look up a Safety exam's result by exam_id. Free. Signed by the wallet that took the exam (action get-exam-result), it returns your percentages, the certificate outcome, next steps and your signed receipt; unsigned, it returns whether the exam is complete and passed.

exam_id.description: The exam_id returned when the exam started.
exam_id.title: Exam Id

nonce.description: A random string of 1-128 characters you choose; each (wallet, nonce) pair works once.
nonce.title: Nonce

signature.description: Optional: sign with the wallet that took the exam (action get-exam-result, a bodyless message) to receive the full result and your signed receipt; send signature, timestamp and nonce together (the exam's own guide, GET /<type>/guide, has the message format).
signature.title: Signature

timestamp.description: Unix time in seconds when you signed, within 5 minutes of the server's clock.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

name: safety_get_exam_result
title: Result of a Safety exam
